purpose: Penn Women's Golf member book, built only from rosters Penn Athletics publishes.

sourceSummary.primarySource: pennathletics.com published women's golf season rosters
sourceSummary.coverageNote: Penn women's golf began varsity competition in 1999-2000, but Penn Athletics publishes season rosters only from 2004-05 onward. The first five varsity seasons are therefore absent from this file. Nothing here is inferred: every member appears on a roster Penn published.

knownMissing.name: Stacy Kress
knownMissing.detail: The program's first recruit, 1999-2000 through 2002-03. First-team All-Ivy as a freshman. Documented in Daily Pennsylvanian archives, absent from Penn's published roster archive.

knownMissing.name: Melissa Aylor
knownMissing.detail: Captain in 2003 and 2005. Only her 2004-05 senior season is published; her first three seasons are not.

sourceSummary.noLetterWinnerSource: No all-time letter-winner record for Penn women's golf has been located. Every letterWinner block reads false for that reason alone. Do not render these members as 'not a letter winner'.
